description: This file defines the TransactionException class, which extends the base Exception class to represent specific exceptions related to transactions within the ORM component of the OrangeHRM system. It is located in the Exception namespace under the ORM directory.

classes.name: TransactionException
classes.description: A custom exception class used to indicate transaction failures within the ORM component, extending the base PHP Exception class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the TransactionException with an optional message, code, and previous Throwable for exception chaining.
